### US defense manufacturer IEH hit by phishing attack
<span class="imp imp-3" title="Importance 3/5" aria-label="Importance 3 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></span> Defense manufacturer IEH Corporation disclosed a phishing attack that compromised an employee's Microsoft 365 mailbox, exposing customer communications, purchase orders, and potentially export-controlled technical data on military satellites, missiles and fighter jets.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Incident discovered August 4, 2026; disclosed in SEC 8-K filing August 7</li>
<li>Attacker impersonated a business contact with a fake Microsoft sharing link</li>
<li>No evidence found that data was copied, exfiltrated, or emails sent from account</li>
<li>IEH secured account, disabled malicious mailbox rules, launched security review</li>
</ul>

Sources: [The Record from Recorded Future News](https://therecord.media/military-device-manufacturer-discloses-cyber-incident) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/08/07/ieh-corp-says-phished-staffer-opened-gates-to-company-m365/) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [securityaffairs.com](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
